title: Arcane Forge
description: Channel arcane essence through mystical reagents to craft legendary artifacts. Combine moon dew, stardust, and crystal shards into items of power.
detailedDescription: Step into a candle-lit forge where arcane energy swirls around ancient tools. Combine mystical reagents — moon dew, stardust, phoenix ash, crystal shards, and void essence — to craft legendary artifacts. Each recipe you discover unlocks new reagents and more powerful items. The crafting system features a satisfying progress loop: gather resources over time, unlock new recipes through experimentation, and build an ever-growing collection of magical items. Between crafting sessions, your reagents accumulate, making this a perfect idle companion.
controls: Click reagents in your inventory to add them to the forge. Click the forge anvil to attempt crafting. Discovered recipes are saved automatically. Resources generate while the game is open.
